description: OKLAHOMA CITY (KSWO) – Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt signed Senate Bill 758 on Monday, May 5, which limits the amount of virtual days public schools can have within a school year. title: Oklahoma Governor signs bill limiting virtual school days - Kristen for Oklahoma
